## scout (ok; 7 turns, 19k in / 970 out, 7 tool calls)

**Answer:** The engine serves routines under `/api/automations` (REST), all defined in `pi-repo/packages/self-learning/src/server.ts` in `handleApi`; there is no `/api/routines` route — the CLI alias `unown routines` maps onto the automations endpoints.

**Endpoints** (all in `server.ts`, M2/M5/M6 semantics):

- `GET /api/automations` — server.ts:261 — list routines (with derived `schedule` + `lastRun` per row)
- `POST /api/automations` — server.ts:269 (inside same branch) — create a routine (cron/every/after/delay/event schedule, mode, misfire, active-hours, retry policy)
- `GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/automations/{id}` — server.ts:381 (regex match at 381, GET at 410, PATCH at 418, DELETE at 464) — get one / edit / delete a routine
- `POST /api/automations/{id}/run` — server.ts:391 — trigger a manual run now (doesn't consume `maxRuns`)
- `POST /api/automations/{id}/skip` — server.ts:397 — skip next occurrence (recorded in history)
- `POST /api/automations/{id}/snooze` — server.ts:404 — snooze next occurrence by N minutes
- `GET /api/automations/{id}/runs?limit=` — server.ts:411 — run history for a routine
- `POST /api/automations/event-dispatch` — server.ts:370 — local event dispatch (same path as inbound webhook; `{event, payload}`)
- Inbound webhook lane: `POST /api/hooks/<hookId>` — server.ts:1113–1142 — auth-by-URL; `GET /api/hooks/info` (server.ts:950) prints the curl-able URL (`unown routines hook-url`)

**Consumers (one line each):**
- `automations-cli.ts:220–493` — `unown routines *` subcommands, one HTTP call per endpoint above
- `tools.ts:2782–2923` — agent tools `routine_list` / `routine_create` / edit / run / delete
- `dashboard/dashboard-data.ts:174,543,671–708` — TUI automations screen + `automationsruns:*` cache

Auth: all routes sit behind the bearer-token gate (`engine-auth.ts:10` notes `POST /api/automations` is arbitrary-prompt execution, hence token-protected).

---

## scout (ok; 3 turns, 15k in / 1k out, 4 tool calls)

## Answer (the six landing-feeding suites)

The six suites that feed the landing-page figures are exactly the `TRACKS` array in `scripts/landing_benchmarks.mjs` (line 79), which writes `src/components/landing/benchmarks-data.ts`. The authoritative contract is in `benchmarks/AGENTS.md` ("The landing-page feed (the definitive contract)", Local Contracts section).

**The six suites (Track N, `benchmarks/` dir, receipt source, landing const):**

| # | Suite (benchmarks/ dir) | Receipt source | Landing const |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **EDIT_BENCH** — `benchmarks/edit-bench/` (TS edit bench, 106 fixtures) | `results/<model>/summary.json` or `results/rerun-<date>/<model>/summary.json` | `EDIT_BENCH` |
| 2 | **HUMANEVAL_PLUS** — `benchmarks/evalplus/` (HumanEval+ 164-problem) | `results/summary.json` (or `rerun-<date>/summary.json`) | `HUMANEVAL_PLUS` |
| 3 | **LIVECODEBENCH** — `benchmarks/livecodebench/` (v6 50-problem post-cutoff) | `results/summary.json` | `LIVECODEBENCH` |
| 4 | **LONGHORIZON** — `benchmarks/longhorizon/` (multi-file refactor, file-diff) | `results/summary.json` | `LONGHORIZON` |
| 5 | **POLYGLOT** — `benchmarks/polyglot/` (Aider polyglot 50-exercise) | `results/summary.json` (or `rerun-<date>/summary.json`) | `POLYGLOT` |
| 6 | **SELFIMPROVE** — `benchmarks/selfimprove/` (repeat-task cold/warm memory) | `results/v2-notes/summary.<model>.json` | `SELFIMPROVE` |

**File:line evidence:**
- `scripts/landing_benchmarks.mjs:79` — `const TRACKS = [` (the six entries at lines 80, 91, 102, 118, 137, 153; each names `constName`, `track`, `resultsDir`).
- `benchmarks/AGENTS.md` — "Local Contracts → The landing-page feed (the definitive contract): `scripts/landing_benchmarks.mjs` reads EXACTLY six receipt paths…" (list items 1–6 above).
- `src/components/landing/benchmarks-data.ts:27` — `BenchTrackName = "EDIT_BENCH" | "HUMANEVAL_PLUS" | "LIVECODEBENCH" | "LONGHORIZON" | "POLYGLOT" | "SELFIMPROVE"`; `BENCH_SOURCES` (lines 37–100) lists each track's per-model receipt paths (provenance) and the emitted `EDIT_BENCH`/`HUMANEVAL_PLUS`/`LIVECODEBENCH`/`LONGHORIZON`/`POLYGLOT`/`SELFIMPROVE` const arrays below.

**Details / how it works:**
- Generator `scripts/landing_benchmarks.mjs` writes the data file; canonical run is resolved PER MODEL — newest `rerun-*` dir that holds a receipt for that model wins, else the base receipt (rules documented in the file's header, lines 16–38, and AGENTS.md "Canonical-run rule").
- Per-model receipt provenance is committed in `BENCH_SOURCES.perModel` (benchmarks-data.ts lines 38–100) — e.g. EDIT_BENCH mixes `rerun-2026-10-17` (kimi/qwen) with `rerun-2026-10-21` (agnes), all listed per model.
- A missing receipt field emits `null` ("not measured"), never a guessed number (AGENTS.md; benchmarks-data.ts header lines 1–11).
- CI gate: `bun run check:benchmarks` asserts the landing figures match the receipts; the generator's own unit suite is `node --test scripts/landing_benchmarks.test.mjs` (benchmarks/AGENTS.md "Verification").
